actions.label: Solution to Doom: Tablet of Ryun'eh
Power in Uldaman: Obsidian Power Source
Uldaman Reagent Run: Magenta Fungus Cap

tips.text: Troggs and dwarves come in mixed packs; earth elementals hit hard, pull them separately.
Archaedas activates guardians in waves; position by the entrance so you can see the whole room.
Collect Power Stones and Shattered Necklace pieces from the trogg area before descending.
Run Uldaman once. Do not reset for more power stones.
At most five dungeon entries/resets per hour. Kill XP inside dungeons is increased by 50%. If any party member would get no XP because the mobs are trivial to them, nobody in the party gets XP.
